note: Whole-country outline: calm-river and lake paddling at Kampot (Green Cathedral loop), Kep and Koh Kong, the Tonle Sap flooded forest near Siem Reap (roughly August to December) and Mekong stretches; no commercial whitewater found. Dry season November to February is best for rivers; 11 paddle launches and rentals mapped.

note: Whole Northeast India outline: 224 peaks above 3,000 m mapped, including Kanchenjunga (8,586 m) on the Sikkim border, Kangto (7,090 m) in Arunachal and a state mountaineering institute at Dirang. Permits and peak royalties limit access; best before and after the monsoon.
